title: flow watch configuration
description: Tunables of factory/bin/flow.sh. ${repo} is the directory above factory/ (or the --repo flag). No tunable lives in the script. flow.sh refuses a config where poll_seconds + stall_seconds is more than visible_within_seconds.

stall_seconds.description: age of a gate record with no consumer record past which it is a stall

busy_grace_seconds.description: a gate record older than stall_seconds is NOT a stall while the consumer role's seat for the ticket reports agent_status working, until the record is this old; past it the seat is judged stuck and the stall is noted. A backstop for a hung turn, not a timer that decides a stall

visible_within_seconds.description: the most a stall may take to reach the board: poll_seconds + stall_seconds must not pass it

watcher_seat.description: the seat name on every note the watcher writes

state_dir.description: ${tree:run}/flow, under the state root. Latch files: one per noted gate record, one per standing belt or pane stall, and the first-start boundary

runner_script.description: factory/bin/route.sh; its status verb is the only definition of a stale belt

runner_config.description: the runner.json that script reads; also names the herdr session

runner_pane_label_regex.description: extended regex a herdr pane label must match for the route runner's pane

role.description: the role whose record is expected next; named in the note

consumers.description: record kinds on the same ticket, written after the gate record, that mean someone took it
